fit_method: same as fit_r2_2026-11-21.py: separation profile, P = 2.5 fixed, relative RK4 r'' = -2K/r^P (A-A, B-B, C-C); per-particle fits for A-B.

grant_001_002.model: pairwise sum, K = 18.0 (flat A-A), P = 2.5, from rest
grant_001_002.rule: RMSE/L <= 0.01 supports pairwise additivity at N = 9; > 0.02 refutes (as in make_2026-11-21_grant.py). 002 is the repeat: both must agree.

close_BB_003_004.rule: mean diagonal K within 5% of 3.83 (3.64 to 4.02) passes the orientation control for B-B; with 001-002 that makes close-BB publishable next round.

close_CC_005_006.rule: mean diagonal K within 5% of 9.50 (9.03 to 9.98) passes the orientation control for C-C; with the horizontal pair that makes close-CC publishable next round.

AA_orientation_at_5_5.rule: difference of the two arm means: |diff| < 2 SE (SE from the six runs per arm, pooled scatter) supports no orientation effect at (5,5); diagonal lower by more than 2 SE supports an orientation effect. Either result is reported; P-0012 scope follows the outcome.

close_AB_012_015.rule: per-particle K_AB (on A) and K_BA (on B). Publish close-AB only if the two horizontal runs (012, 013) and the two diagonal runs (014, 015) each agree within 5% in both K values, and the horizontal and diagonal means agree within 5%.
close_AB_012_015.discriminator: ratio K_AB/K_BA at r0 1.0 compared with the separation-5 ratio 8.99/12.34 = 0.728. If the ratio at r0 1.0 is within 5% of 0.728, the pair coefficients share one radial shape (close-range scale factor); if not, the close range is species-specific in shape.

review_P0016_016_018.model: P-0016 claim as published (K_AC = -6.25, K_CA = -14.78, P = 2.5, repulsion), predicted_error 0.006, bar 3x = 0.018
review_P0016_016_018.rule: all three in-domain runs <= 0.018: replicated. All three > 0.018: falsified. Mixed: narrowed, with the failing orientation or ordering named.
